review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one definition of its own, `componentField`. That definition is a named specialisation of the project's `mapField` (the `mapField` definition is in LpSmoothFieldAlgebra.lean) applied to `EuclideanSpace.proj j`. The file uses it to state `componentField_apply`, the norm bounds and the Laplacian identity, so it is a useful named wrapper and not a competing concept. The other declarations are theorems, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. Two project-level notions could be compared with Mathlib: `partialDerivative`, which is `fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)`, and `axis`, which is `EuclideanSpace.single i 1`. Both are defined in other files, not in the target, and I did not assess them against Mathlib. The target only uses them. `operator_norm_le_of_entries` is a theorem, and I did not establish that it duplicates an existing Mathlib lemma. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
